artifact_hierarchy.rule: Every substantive item in the DOCX is generated from the model. Nothing substantive may exist only in the DOCX, and no reviewable item may exist only in the Markdown.

external_manual_docx.page_count_note: docProps/app.xml declares Pages=1 and Words=0, which Word writes when a document has never been repaginated by the application. The real page count is not readable from the package, and no renderer is available to determine it.
divergences_observed: reviewer instructions ('Cara semak') present in the DOCX, absent from the Markdown
a 'Ringkasan cadangan' totals line present only in the DOCX

TWO different final-verdict vocabularies in one document — 'Lulus / Lulus dengan pindaan / Perlu dibaiki' near the top and 'Lulus untuk generate storyboard / Lulus dengan pindaan / Belum lulus' at the end
decision checkboxes abbreviated to A / E / M / R, which a reviewer cannot expand without the legend
MERGE offered with no target-ID field, so a merge decision could not be recorded
'Arahan selepas semakan' instructions present only in the DOCX
external_manual_docx.conclusion: It is a competent human document. It is not a governed one: six classes of substantive content existed only inside it.

document_metadata.opening_disclosure_ms: Semua kandungan dalam dokumen ini ialah draf CAIR untuk semakan Bariah. Bariah kekal sebagai satu-satunya Instructional Designer dan pihak yang menyemak, meminda serta meluluskan kandungan. Storyboard PowerPoint dan aset MMD belum dihasilkan.
status_lines_ms: Kelulusan diperlukan bagi perbualan, Rumusan, kuiz, susunan skrin dan kumpulan visual.

lines_ms: Tandakan TERIMA jika item boleh dikekalkan seperti yang dicadangkan.
Tandakan PINDA dan tulis pindaan yang dikehendaki dalam ruang komen.
Tandakan BUANG jika item tidak sepatutnya digunakan.
Tandakan GABUNG hanya untuk skrin atau kumpulan visual, dan WAJIB tulis ID item yang hendak digabungkan serta sebabnya. Tanpa ID, gabungan tidak boleh dilaksanakan.
GABUNG bermaksud dua item dijadikan satu. Ia berbeza daripada perkongsian visual, yang mempunyai ruangan tersendiri.
Bagi perbualan, Rumusan dan kuiz, pilihan hanya TERIMA, PINDA atau BUANG.
reviewer_instructions.merge_rule_ms: GABUNG memerlukan ID sasaran. Kotak GABUNG tanpa ID tidak boleh diterima sebagai keputusan.

merge_rule.constraint: MERGE is a relationship, not a standalone checkbox. A MERGE with no target ID is not a decision — it records that the reviewer wanted something merged without saying with what, which cannot be actioned.
merge_rule.not_the_same_as_reuse: MERGE combines two proposed items into one. REUSE shares one produced asset across more than one screen. Conflating them would let a reuse answer silently delete a screen.

do_not_reuse_items.reason_ms: Penyimpanan baja (kering, selamat, jauh dari air) berbeza daripada penyimpanan racun (berkunci, berlabel, berpengudaraan).
PPE untuk baja (sarung tangan, topeng muka) berbeza daripada PPE untuk racun (topeng pernafasan, cermin mata, sarung tangan kimia, sut pelindung).
Set PPE racun jauh lebih berat dan tidak boleh dikongsi dengan skrin baja.

visual_asset_grouping.reuse_question_ms: Selain visual yang telah ditandakan tidak boleh digunakan semula, adakah visual lain boleh dikongsi antara lebih daripada satu skrin?
visual_asset_grouping.reuse_question_rule: The question must name the known constraints first. An unrestricted 'adakah visual tertentu boleh digunakan semula?' hides three items that are already known not to be shareable.

quiz.scope_ms: Terpakai kepada semua PL dalam Kursus
quiz.source_evidence_caveat_placement: internal run manifest and QA report only — not shown to Bariah, where it would read as doubt about the questions rather than a custody note

distractor_review.concern: Options E and F were direct negations of stated duties — empty containers may be reused, spraying needs no notification. Both are refutable without understanding the material, which lowers discrimination.
distractor_review.search_scope: The controlled T04 extract only. No external knowledge, no invented fact.

option_mapping.old: Bekas racun kosong boleh digunakan semula untuk kegunaan lain
option_mapping.new: Baja disimpan di tempat yang kering dan jauh dari sumber air
option_mapping.new_basis: T04-ROW-041 — TRUE of fertiliser storage, not a pesticide-spraying control

option_mapping.old: Semburan boleh dijalankan tanpa memaklumkan penduduk sekitar
option_mapping.new: Rekod pembajaan disimpan sebagai bukti kerja untuk tuntutan bayaran
option_mapping.new_basis: T04-ROW-045 — TRUE of fertiliser records, not a pesticide-spraying control

distractor_review.trade_off: The old distractors could be eliminated by anyone who noticed they were absurd. The new ones require the learner to attribute a control to the correct operation. That is better discrimination, but option F is a fine distinction — 'rekod pembajaan' against the spraying record duty in T04-ROW-078 — and a reviewer could reasonably call it a trick. Flagged for Bariah rather than decided.
distractor_review.bariah_note_ms: Pilihan E dan F ialah kenyataan yang BETUL dalam modul, tetapi ia berkaitan baja, bukan kawalan semasa semburan racun. Tujuannya supaya pelajar perlu membezakan kawalan mengikut operasi. Jika Bariah rasa ini terlalu halus, kedua-dua pilihan boleh ditukar.

items.display_text: Apakah tiga operasi utama penyelenggaraan landskap lembut yang dinyatakan dalam modul?
items.internal_answer_evidence: Three Heading-3 operations sit under Landskap Lembut: Siram (T04-ROW-006), Baja (T04-ROW-026), Racun (T04-ROW-046).

items.display_text: Sebuah projek memerlukan pengairan automatik bagi kawasan rumput yang luas. Mengikut modul, sistem manakah yang paling sesuai?
items.internal_provenance: source rows T04-ROW-012, T04-ROW-013, T04-ROW-014, T04-ROW-015
items.internal_answer_evidence: T04-ROW-013 states the sprinkler system is 'sesuai untuk kawasan rumput yang luas'; T04-ROW-015 states drip is for individual trees and shrubs.

items.display_text: Mengikut susunan keutamaan IPM dalam modul, kaedah kawalan manakah yang disenaraikan paling akhir?
items.internal_provenance: source rows T04-ROW-048, T04-ROW-049, T04-ROW-051, T04-ROW-053, T04-ROW-055
items.internal_answer_evidence: T04-ROW-048 introduces the priority list and the module then gives Kawalan Kultur, Kawalan Fizikal, Kawalan Biologi and Kawalan Kimia in that order.

items.display_text: Modul menyenaraikan empat kumpulan fungsi landskap kejur. Kumpulan manakah yang merangkumi kerja menstabilkan tanah dan menguruskan aliran air?
items.internal_provenance: source rows T04-ROW-081, T04-ROW-086, T04-ROW-087, T04-ROW-089, T04-ROW-091, T04-ROW-096
items.internal_answer_evidence: T04-ROW-086 Fungsi Struktur dan Kejuruteraan has exactly two sub-headings: Menstabilkan Tanah (T04-ROW-087) and Pengurusan Air (T04-ROW-089).

items.display_text: Pilih SEMUA kawalan yang mesti dipatuhi oleh kontraktor semasa aktiviti semburan racun, mengikut modul.

Pekerja mesti memakai PPE yang lengkap dan bersesuaian
Semburan hanya dilakukan semasa cuaca tenang
Salinan Helaian Data Keselamatan (SDS) disimpan di tapak

items.internal_provenance: source rows T04-ROW-067, T04-ROW-069, T04-ROW-070, T04-ROW-074, T04-ROW-076, T04-ROW-041, T04-ROW-045
items.internal_answer_evidence: A — T04-ROW-067 licensed or trained operator. B — T04-ROW-069 and T04-ROW-070 full PPE. C — T04-ROW-076 calm weather only. D — T04-ROW-074 SDS copy kept on site. E is true of fertiliser storage (T04-ROW-041), not of pesticide spraying. F is true of fertiliser records (T04-ROW-045); the spraying record duty is a different row.

cross_item_dependencies.note_ms: Jika ayat 04 dipinda atau dibuang kerana generalisasi terlalu luas, wording Q5 perlu disemak semula supaya kekal khusus kepada kawalan racun yang dinyatakan dalam modul.
cross_item_dependencies.internal_note: Editing or removing Rumusan 04 does NOT invalidate Q5. It triggers a consistency review, because both express how broadly contractor duties are stated.
